# Anthrix
> Anthrix is a Software and AI Studio that designs and builds high-performance web applications, SaaS platforms, AI agents, RAG systems, and workflow automations for businesses worldwide.

## About
Anthrix was founded in 2024. We are a technical studio focused on delivering serious digital infrastructure - not templates or cookie-cutter solutions.

## Services
- Web Application Development: Custom full-stack web apps built for performance and scale.
- SaaS Platform Development: End-to-end SaaS products with auth, billing, dashboards, and multi-tenancy.
- AI Agent Development: Autonomous AI agents that perform real-world tasks, handle leads, and integrate with business workflows.
- RAG System Development: Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems that give AI accurate, context-aware answers from your own data.
- Workflow Automation: Business process automation using n8n and custom pipelines.
- WhatsApp Business Automation: AI-powered WhatsApp bots for customer support, lead capture, and appointment booking.

## Tech Expertise
Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, Prisma, AI/ML integrations (OpenAI, Groq, Anthropic), and cloud infrastructure (Vercel, AWS, GCP).

## Target Clients
Startups, SMBs, and enterprises that need reliable, scalable digital products and AI automation.
